dedupe_keys.name: dynamic ieee test systems dynamic generator exciter and governor data for the ieee 9 to 300 bus systems kios university of cyprus

description: The Dynamic IEEE Test Systems extend the standard IEEE power system test cases, which were published for steady-state studies, with the dynamic data needed for time-domain transient simulation. They are published in open access by researchers at the KIOS Research and Innovation Center of Excellence of the University of Cyprus, and are described by Demetriou, Asprou, Quirós-Tortós and Kyriakides in the IEEE Systems Journal (vol. 11, no. 4, 2017). Coverage: modified IEEE 9, 14, 30, 39, 57, 118 and 300 bus systems; for each generator the dynamic parameters of a sixth-order machine model with exciter and governor are defined, and parameters are also given for synchronous condensers and motors, based on the typical models in Anderson and Fouad's Power System Control and Stability. Format and access: one web page per system with a one-line diagram and a PDF of the dynamic data, free to download. Licence: open access as stated on the site; no formal licence named. Caveats: the data are typical, not measured values, only PDF tables were found (no simulator-ready files were listed on the pages read), and the site has not changed since 2020. Simulation uses: transient stability, controlled islanding and restoration studies on small standard grids, for cascading failure and resilience analysis. Related records: PGLib-OPF (data-pglib-opf) holds the steady-state versions of many IEEE test cases, and the KIOS EPANET benchmarks (data-epanet-benchmarks) come from the same research centre.
